A little note for grown-ups

Practise at your child’s pace. Phonics Starters connects each letter to a beginning word; it is not a complete phonics course. Cursive uses the Playwrite India style, and school handwriting forms may differ.

No account is needed. Quiz scores stay on this device, and we do not save a child’s name, answers or voice recordings. Audio depends on the browser’s English voices and may use an online speech service.
